name: filetree
description: An IDE-style file tree for Claude Code that shows what Claude is doing and where in files

activity.title: Claude activity
activity.description: Which of Claude's file activity shimmers in the tree: files read with the Read tool or Bash readers (rg, grep, find, cat) in purple, writes in orange and git actions in green

glyphs.title: Glyphs
glyphs.description: Icon set: auto uses Nerd Font icons when one is installed here, except in the desktop app; plain uses Unicode only

theme.title: Theme
theme.description: Pane colours: auto follows Omarchy's current theme when there is one, else the built-in colours; or a named palette. The pane keeps the terminal's own background.

corners.title: Corners
corners.description: round: the cursor row is a pill with rounded ends and the search field sits in a rounded box; square: full-width row bars and a bare search field.

follow.title: Follow Claude
follow.description: on: the tree scrolls to what Claude reads, writes or commits. off: the view stays where you put it and only your own scrolling moves it; highlights still show.

column.title: Right column
column.description: What the right column shows by default: date (last modified) or size (files in bytes, folders as disk usage computed in the background). The header button toggles it.

keys.title: Tree keys
keys.description: Overrides for the keys inside the tree, as command=key,key pairs separated by ; (e.g. top=g g,home; hide=q,x). Commands: down up halfPageDown halfPageUp pageDown pageUp top bottom expand collapse open toggle parent search copyPath copyAbsolutePath refresh toggleHidden toggleSize collapseAll hide. Empty keeps the defaults.

toggleAction.title: Show/hide action
toggleAction.description: The Claude Code keybinding action that shows and hides the tree; bind a key to it in ~/.claude/keybindings.json (Global context). Use an action Claude Code is not handling at the time; empty turns it off.

focusAction.title: Focus action
focusAction.description: The Claude Code keybinding action that opens the tree and gives it the keyboard; bind a key to it in ~/.claude/keybindings.json (Global context). Empty turns it off.
